mentions.name: Lobu
mentions.description: A multi-tenant version of OpenClaw for organizations with a shared memory layer. It includes an entity-based agent context layer that can be used as an OpenClaw plugin, and a sandbox runtime layer built on just-bash with pi that lets users expose the context via a bot and an API.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on multi-tenant version of OpenClaw for organizations that has shared memory layer. It includes an entity based agent context layer that can be used as OpenClaw plugin and a sandbox runtime layer which uses just-bash with pi and let you expose the context via a bot an API.
